Data completeness: full months, real administrative boundary — 11021 recorded incidents total across 3 months (2026-04–2026-06), queried against Croydon's actual ONS 2021 polygon outline (the same shape shown on the map above), not an approximate circle. This is the complete monthly response from the UK Police API for each month in that window. Day score: 3.1159 weighted incidents/1,000 people, averaged over the last 3 months (124% of the 32-borough average). Night score: 14.1525 weighted incidents/1,000 people, same window (116% of the 32-borough average). Both are normalised by an estimated workday/footfall population of 311,966 (2021 resident population of 390,700, scaled by a measured resident-vs-workday ratio from the ONS's 2011 Census release for Croydon — see methodology) rather than plain resident population, so central boroughs with heavy commuter/visitor footfall aren't overstated as riskier just for having fewer official residents. Rated against the average of the 32 boroughs currently on the automated pipeline.
